about_me.des: I'm a Senior Manager leading the AI Lab at Rovio, focused on building AI systems that combine technical depth, creativity, and real product impact. I've led projects ranging from production-ready ML models to generative AI tools that help artists, designers, and developers work faster and more effectively. I'm especially interested in how AI and creativity come together to create better products and experiences for players.

career.rovio_ai_des: Leading Rovio's AI Lab, dedicated to prototyping and validating high-impact generative AI and ML solutions for game development. Driving the AI strategy, defining the technical roadmap, and fostering adoption of AI across the company.
career.rovio_lead_des: Progressed from Machine Learning Engineer to Principal ML Engineer, leading Rovio's ML engineering team across Personalization, Ads and User Acquisition. Spearheaded the AI strategy and governance, and led the design of generative AI tools, LLM and agentic systems for creative teams.
career.ey_des: Led and delivered AI and data engineering projects for financial and insurance clients, directing multidisciplinary teams from concept to production. Built OCR and deep learning systems for automated document understanding and helped clients deploy Big Data and cloud platforms.
career.ey_job: Senior Consultant, Data Science & Data Engineering
career.qliro_des: Created Scala-based ETL pipelines to migrate large datasets from SQL to Hadoop and developed fraud detection models using Spark ML, while contributing to the company's data infrastructure modernization initiative.
career.kth_des: Second year of my EIT Digital Data Science Master. Specialization in Distributed Systems and Data Mining for Really Big Data.
career.indizen_des: I did an internship with Indizen, a Spanish consulting company, as a member of its Big Data department. I was involved in a project to detect and analyze geolocated social media data to find emerging news in Barcelona for a newspaper.
career.vaciatucasa_des: I developed a Point of Sale software program for Vaciatucasa. This company needed a POS system to enable street market sells.
career.upm_des: I pursued my first year in the EIT Digital Data Science double degree program.
career.crida_des: I worked at CRIDA as a developer in the context of European Air Traffic Control projects. I was in charge of designing ETL processes to load data into the company's data warehouse.
career.degree_des: I was pursuing my Bachelor's Degree in Mathematics and Informatics.

publications.kth_title: Fraud detection in online payments using Spark ML
publications.kth_data: Master Thesis, Royal Institute of Technology (KTH), Stockholm, Sweden, 2017.
publications.upm_title: Presencia en Twitter de los candidatos a las elecciones madrileñas de 2015
